v.title: Naderi’s Punch Keeps Rangers in the Game, but Barça Fans Shouldn’t Lose Focus
v.excerpt: Naderi’s late header gives Rangers a vital win, keeping their title hopes alive in a tight Scottish Premiership race.
v.body:
## Quick take
Ryan Naderi’s late header against Rangers was the sole goal of a Scottish Premiership match that ended 1‑0. The punch, though modest, secured Rangers’ point tally and kept their title hopes alive.

## What happened
The match opened with a flurry of goals across the league, but Rangers’ encounter with Celtic remained a tight shoot‑out. In the 72nd minute, Naderi found the back of the net from a corner, his powerful header slipping past the keeper and giving Rangers a 1‑0 advantage.

The goal was not flashy, but it was decisive. Rangers were under pressure from Celtic’s relentless attack, and the lone goal ensured a clean sheet. The match ended with Rangers holding onto the win, a crucial point that keeps them in contention for the Premiership title.

## Why it matters
- **For Rangers**: The win keeps them within striking distance of Celtic, maintaining the pressure on the leaders and preserving their momentum heading into the final stretch of the season.
- **For Naderi**: His ability to deliver a clutch header demonstrates his value as a versatile defender who can contribute offensively—an attribute that could boost his standing for future selection in national squads.
- **For the Scottish Premiership**: The result highlights the league’s competitive nature, where even a single moment of brilliance can alter the title race, reminding clubs that consistency and opportunistic play are key.

## What's next
Watch Rangers’ next fixture against Aberdeen. With the team now on a winning streak, they’ll look to extend their lead and keep Celtic at bay. Naderi will likely be a key target in set‑piece situations, so keep an eye on his positioning and aerial threat. If Rangers can replicate the decisive goal‑scoring moment, they’ll be in a strong position to challenge for the Premiership title before the season’s final matchday.

*Source: [Naderi's 'lucky punch' keeps Rangers in touch](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ckzd930mjp1po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)*
